raw_segments.text: Distimona. Alas, thrice-gentle Cassio, my advocation is not now in tune, my lord is
not my lord, nor should I know him were he in favor as in humor altered. So help me every
spirit sanctified as I have spoken for you all my best and stood within the blank of
his displeasure for my free speech. You must awhile be patient. What I can do I will, and
more I will than for myself I dare. Let that suffice you.
